== Summary ==
Score sheet for the round of 12 of the 1999 [[Star Wars CCG]] World Championship, from the [[DecipherCon 1999 website]], as archived on 19 December 2000. Screenshot of the Internet Archive's copy, rendered in a desktop browser at 800 pixels wide. See [[DecipherCon 1999 website]] and [[1999 Decipher World Championship]].

* [http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW03_1.html DecipherCon 1999 event scores: SW03_1], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001219103500/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW03_1.html Internet Archive]
* Rendered with headless Chrome (Playwright) on 27 October 2026 from the archived HTML and the archived images. Site-wide decipher.com icons that the Wayback Machine did not save are left blank.
* Page content: Decipher.
